one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Secunderabad-headquartered manufacturer and trader of adhesive tapes, die-cuts, rubbing and polishing compounds, buffing pads and car-care products for the automotive OEM and auto-refinish markets, seeking a listing on the NSE Emerge SME platform.

business_model.title: Business (RHP)
business_model.body: Two streams. The manufacturing division produces adhesive tapes and die-cuts, pre-taped masking film, rubbing and polishing compounds, buffing and foam pads, reflective tapes and printing solutions, domes and graphics, and a range of car care products, made at Unit I (SIPCOT Industrial Park, Sriperumbudur, Tamil Nadu) and Unit II (IMT Manesar, Haryana) under ISO 9001:2015, IATF 16949:2016, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certifications, with customisation offered to clients. The trading segment resells electrical and pneumatic tools, abrasive sheets, discs and rolls, body shop consumables, …

products.title: Products (RHP)
products.body:
- Manufactured range for the Automotive OEM and Auto Refinish markets; die-cuts used mainly for bumper masking in cars and two-wheelers. The Company states it is among the few with in-line doming application units, producing domed labels in acrylic for consumer-durables and domed emblems for automotive and white goods.
- Traded segment supplying the automotive aftermarket / refinish channel.

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: The Company describes itself as operating both a manufacturing division (adhesive tapes and die-cuts, pre-taped masking film, rubbing and polishing compounds, buffing and foam pads, reflective tapes, domes and graphics, car care products) and a trading division (tools, abrasives, body shop consumables, retail products, accessories and aerosols), so a portion of what it sells is bought-in rather than made. On the inbound side it is not backward integrated: raw materials such as Jumbo Rolls, Solvents, Skins, Heat Film and Velcro are sourced from a combination of domestic and foreign suppliers, with imports from China, Japan, Portugal, Taiwan, the United States of America, Spain, Thailand, South Korea, Vietnam, Germany, Malaysia and Turkey; the cost of raw material consumed represented 37.01%, 43.26%, 44.29% and 47.10% of total revenues in the period ended September 30, 2025 and Fiscals 2025, 2024 and 2023 respectively. Conversion is done in-house at two manufacturing units (Sriperumbudur, Tamil Nadu and IMT Manesar, Haryana) using UV machines, dome machines, filling machines, label printing machines, shrink tunnels, pre-tape masking paper machines, masker roller machines, die-punching machines and cone high-lift pallet trucks, with an in-house testing laboratory and an R&D team; the Company states it is among the few with in-line doming application units. Outbound, the Company states it operates a Kanban / Just-in-Time inventory system to minimise stock levels, and reaches market through a dual-segment route: direct long-term B2B supply to automotive OEMs, and distributors, e-commerce platforms and direct sales for the B2C/B2B refinish market.

demand_drivers.title: Seasonality (RHP report)
demand_drivers.body: Per the DRHP: 'Our business is dependent to a certain extent on the seasonal, environmental and climate changes. Hence, our business is seasonal in nature.'

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Rising costs, supply disruptions, and import restrictions on essential raw materials may impact our expenses, timelines, and overall financial performance.
- The prices of our primary raw materials, including those imported for the production of Adhesive Tapes, Polishing and Buffing Pads, Rubbing and Polishing Compounds have been volatile.
- We source raw materials such as Jumbo Rolls, Solvents, Skins, Heat Film and Velcro for our manufacturing operations from a combination of domestic and foreign suppliers.
- Raw materials used in the manufacturing of Adhesive Tapes, Rubbing and Polishing Compounds, and Buffing Pads are global commodities, and their prices tend to be cyclical, fluctuating in response to global market conditions.
- Our raw materials are imported from China, Japan, Portugal, Taiwan, United States of America, Spain, Thailand, South Korea, Vietnam, Germany, Malaysia and Turkey.
- If the costs of these raw materials rise due to factors such as rise in input and commodity prices or shortages in supply, and our Company is not able to recover these costs through cost saving measures elsewhere or by increasing the prices of its products, our results of operations could be adversely affected.
- In the event prices for these raw materials subsequently decline there can be no assurance that our Company will be able to price our products based on the material costs it actually incurred.
- Our Registered Office and Manufacturing unit from where we operate is not owned by us.
